Labels: THE EMBER FLOWS UPWARD. FOLLOW IT.
Choose your wanderer, attributes and weapon cards.
Includes starting equipment and relic bonuses.
Max HP +10. Your first attack each combat also deals 4 Poise damage.
Fights up close and switches footing mid-battle — one stance hits harder, the other holds the line. Wounds you land keep bleeding, and heavy blows stagger.
Casts in sequence — the second spell each turn strikes harder than the first. Fragile early on, so the order you play cards matters more than their power.
Sets up a clean opening, then turns speed, poison, and opportunism into decisive strikes before the enemy can recover.
Spends its own health to act, then heals it back. Spreads a rot that damages enemies over time. One pool for everything, so mistakes stack up fast.
+1 total damage on strength attacks; +1 carry capacity.
+1 total arcane damage and +1 card healing.
Base resources before equipment and relic bonuses. 3 hp / 1 mana flask charges.
Custom climbs keep original unlock progression and have separate win-rate records.
Shrine rest and between-act healing are halved.
Every enemy begins combat with +1 Strength.
Begin the run with a Guilt curse shuffled into your deck.
Every monster node is an Elite fight.
Start with +250 cinders — but every shop price doubles.
Card rewards ignore rarity: rares everywhere.
You deal +25% damage, but take +25% damage.
After Act 3 the spire loops — each cycle, foes gain HP and Strength. Only death ends the climb.

Act 1: 12 floors × 7 columns.
Act 2: 12 floors × 7 columns.
Act 3: 12 floors × 7 columns.
Open Run shape to sample map density.
Share of the roll, not of the finished map — floor rules and the no-repeat-neighbour ban still override it.
